kalyāṇaputhujjana.p: [Kalyāṇa+puthujjana] (pu) CL=7  A magnanimous ordinary man (i.e., who has not attained a path but is practicing for it). (learning Pāḷi (such as the five aggregate of being, Āyatana, dhātu), Asking the meaning and discussing, listening, observing, and contemplation. This person is called Kalyāṇaputhujjana).
